units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 8:17">Tosef. B. Kam. VIII, 17</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יפרוס את הק׳ וכ׳</he> provided one does not spread the sail and detain the boat (when fishing in the waters of a neighboring tribe).—Pl. <he>קְלָעִים</he>, <he>קְלָעִין</he>.

Eduy. VIII, 6; Zeb. 107ᵇ; Meg. 10ᵃ, a. e. כשהיו … ק׳ להיכל וק׳ לעזרות when they were rebuilding the Temple, they made curtains for the Temple and curtains for the courts.—Esp. the curtains of the Tabernacle; trnsf. the partitions of the Temple corresponding to those of the Tabernacle.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:3">Zeb. V, 3</cite> <he>לפנים מן הק׳</he> inside of the enclosures (in the Temple court); a. e.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:8">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>עֲשֵׂה להן ק׳ וכ׳</he> put up shops for them and place therein prostitutes &c.; <he>עָשָׂה להן ק׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>קעילין</he>) he put up shops for them &c.; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>ק׳</he> Var. (ed. <cite ref="M02392"><he>מקולין</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 771:11">Yalk. ib. 771</cite> <he>קעילין</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:15">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> top <he>קנקלין</he>).
